clues.title: Plate: long white with maroon strip
text: Regular cars in Qatar have **long, white** licence plates with a **maroon** strip on the left. Trucks have **square, black** licence plates and police plates are blue.

images.caption: Qatari plates: standard, black commercial and blue police

clues.summary: Cars have long white plates with a maroon strip on the left. Trucks have square black plates and police plates are blue.

clues.title: Google car: blurred white pickup, left antenna
text: The Google car will usually be **blurred**, with only the **antenna on the left and** a sliver of the car visible. Sometimes the entire **white pickup truck** can be visible. Rusty clips can be seen on the crossbar.
_See the region guessing section for more information._
clues.summary: The car is usually blurred, leaving only an antenna on the left and a sliver of the white pickup truck. Rusty clips show on the roof crossbar.

clues.title: Landscape: flat sandy desert
text: Qatar's landscape is **predominantly desert**, with **arid**, and **mostly flat** expanses of sand as far as the eye can see. You will often not see a lot of trees or other greenery.
clues.summary: Flat, dry, sandy land stretching far, with very few trees or other greenery.

clues.title: Road lines: solid white edges
text: Qatar typically uses **solid outer white lines** with either white or yellow in the middle. More rarely, you can also find outer yellow lines too.
clues.summary: Solid white lines at the edges, with a white or yellow line in the middle. Yellow edge lines also exist but are rarer.

clues.title: Pole: round, three insulators, diagonal braces
text: Qatar uses **round** poles with 3 insulators on the pole top, with the middle one being slightly higher. The crossbar also has 2 diagonal bars connecting it to the pole.

images.caption: Round pole with three insulators and diagonal braces, marked by the red circle at left
Round pole with three insulators and diagonal braces, marked by the red circle at left

clues.summary: A round pole with three insulators on top, the middle one slightly higher. The crossbar is held by two diagonal braces.

clues.title: Chevron: white on red or blue
text: Qatar uses **white on red** and **white on blue** chevrons.
clues.summary: Curve-warning chevrons are white arrows on a red or a blue background.

clues.title: Coverage: World Cup banners
text: Since some coverage was taken before the **2022 World Cup** took place, many banners can be seen mentioning the event.
clues.summary: Some coverage was shot before the 2022 World Cup, so many banners mention the event.

clues.title: Sign: crossing sign with man in long white robe
text: Qatari crossing signs feature a man in a [**thobe**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Thawb).
clues.summary: Pedestrian crossing signs show a man wearing a thobe, the long robe worn by Gulf men.

clues.title: Coverage: nearly every main road
text: Qatar is pretty well covered, with almost every main road and some side roads having coverage. Only the south and west lack coverage at the moment.
clues.summary: Almost every main road and some side roads are covered. Only the south and the west have no coverage.

clues.title: Street sign: numbered zones
text: Qatar is divided into municipalities, further divided into **numbered zones**, which can be seen on [street signs](https://goo.gl/maps/M8fdWeriuhXw3Meu5). This infographic shows which number corresponds to each zone.
clues.summary: Street signs show a zone number, because the country is split into numbered zones inside municipalities. Learn which numbers sit where.

clues.title: Google car: very short antenna
text: This very **short** antenna is found in northern Qatar.

images.caption: Red circle marks the very short antenna at the left of the road ahead

clues.summary: A very short antenna on the car points to the north of the country.

clues.title: Google car: fairly long antenna
text: This **fairly long** antenna is found in and around Doha.

images.caption: Large red circle marks the fairly long antenna at the left of the road

clues.summary: A fairly long antenna points to the capital and the area around it.

clues.title: Google car: long antenna
text: And this **long** antenna is mostly found in southwestern Qatar.
clues.summary: A long antenna on the car is mostly seen in the south-west.

clues.title: Bollards: only on a few roads
text: **Bollards **in Qatar are only found on a few roads, and you can easily tell them apart.
- The horizontal [road just west of Qatar map label](https://maps.app.goo.gl/gTG4kNoWi6Nvgzgd9#extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng) uses black and yellow centre lines.
- The horizontal [road south of Madinat al Ka`ban](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8zw6N5R1F83nVcoE7#extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng) has a lot more greenery and, the coverage is also very overcast.
- The [coastal road south of Fuwayrit](https://maps.app.goo.gl/TccRhQzayTorZkmP9#extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng) has coastal shrubs all around, and you can often see the coast.
- If the road doesn’t fit the above descriptions, guess on [the long vertical road west of Qatar map label](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Zc4PecYmyuGQXYju7#extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng).
clues.summary: Bollards exist only on a few roads, each recognisable. One has black and yellow centre lines, one is greener and overcast, and one is coastal with shrubs. Anything else, guess the long north-south road.

clues.title: Stadium: black and white stripes, tent roof
text: Al Bayt Stadium can be recognized by the black and white **horizontal stripes** on the stadium along with the tent-like roof.
clues.summary: A stadium with black and white horizontal stripes and a tent-shaped roof.

clues.title: Stadium: golden bowl shape
text: Lusail Stadium, in Lusail, can be recognized by its golden **bowl-like** shape.
clues.summary: A big stadium shaped like a golden bowl, in the new city of Lusail.

clues.title: Towers: four, twisted like a screw thread
text: **Four towers**, resembling a **screw thread**, can be seen from almost every point in Lusail.

images.caption: Four tall towers with twisted, screw-thread facades

clues.summary: Four towers that look like a screw thread, visible from almost everywhere in the new city of Lusail.

clues.title: Structure: gahfiya shape near a stadium
text: A structure resembling a **gahfiya** can be seen around the Ahmed bin Ali Stadium, in Rawdat Al Jahhaniya district.
clues.summary: A structure shaped like a gahfiya (a traditional woven cap) stands by a stadium in the Rawdat Al Jahhaniya district.

clues.title: Mall: boxy building covered in ads
text: The **Mall of Qatar** in Rawdat Al Jahhaniya can be recognized by the boxy appearance with many ads on the side of the building. Large [car parks](https://goo.gl/maps/HH42iSf57P7GxfVD9) are also seen next to the mall.
clues.summary: A boxy shopping mall with many adverts on its walls and big car parks beside it, in the Rawdat Al Jahhaniya district.

clues.title: Stadium: grey diamond-pattern cladding
text: Education City Stadium can be recognized by the large, **grey** cladding with a **diamond pattern**.
clues.summary: A stadium covered in large grey panels with a diamond pattern, in Education City.

clues.title: Road: black-tiled surface
text: Education City features distinct **black-tiled **roads.

images.caption: A road paved with black tiles

clues.summary: Roads covered in black tiles are found in Education City.

clues.title: Street sign: brown, often ground-fixed
text: **Brown **street signs, often fixed to the ground, are seen in Education City.
clues.summary: Brown street signs, often fixed low in the ground, are seen in Education City.

clues.title: Stadium: twin arches like an open mouth
text: Khalifa International Stadium can be recognized by the **dual arches** shaped like a wide open mouth.
clues.summary: A stadium with two arches shaped like a wide open mouth.

clues.title: Tower: tallest, hourglass-shaped
text: The Torch Tower can be seen from almost every point in the Baaya District, and can be recognized by its **hyperboloid** structure, along with it being the tallest building in Qatar.
clues.summary: The tallest building in the country, with a curved hyperboloid (hourglass) shape. It is visible from almost anywhere in the Baaya district.

clues.title: Google car: cardboard box on the right of the bed
text: This **cardboard box** in the right side of the bed is seen in Lusail. The rusty clips will also be visible.
NOTE: The box will not always be visible. Make sure to look out for other clues before guessing.

images.caption: Google car: a cardboard box on the right of the car, marked with a red circle and arrow

clues.summary: A cardboard box on the right side of the truck bed points to Lusail. The box is not always visible, so check other clues.

clues.title: Google car: black box on the left of the bed
text: This **black box** on the **left** side of the bed is seen southeast of Ar-Rayyan, around the green area.
NOTE: The box will not always be visible. Make sure to look out for other clues before guessing.

images.caption: Google car: a black box on the left of the car, marked with a red circle and arrow

clues.summary: A black box on the left side of the truck bed points to the green area southeast of Ar-Rayyan. It is not always visible.

clues.title: Google car: black box on the right of the bed
text: The **black box** on the **right** side of the bed is seen in Al Khor, and in the green area around The Torch Tower and Khalifa International Stadium.
NOTE: The box will not always be visible. Make sure to look out for other clues before guessing.

images.caption: Google car: a black box on the right of the car, marked with a red circle and arrow

clues.summary: A black box on the right side of the truck bed points to Al Khor, and to the green area around the Torch Tower and a large stadium. It is not always visible.

clues.title: Coverage: tripod inside airport and plane
text: A **tripod** was used to capture the interior of the Hamad International Airport. A unique tripod that captured the [inside of a plane](https://goo.gl/maps/Bgbsuqhkc4g98q1E7) can also be seen here.

images.caption: Coverage taken on a tripod inside an airport terminal and on a plane

clues.summary: A tripod captured the inside of the main airport, and a unique tripod also covered the inside of a plane there.

clues.title: Google car: white pickup, left antenna
text: Qatar's landscape is predominantly desert, with arid, mostly flat expanses of sand as far as the eye can see. You will often not see many trees or other greenery.
The Google car will usually be blurred, with only the antenna on the left and a sliver of the car visible. Sometimes the entire white pickup truck can be visible.
You might occasionally confuse it with the UAE or Oman pickup truck coverage, but in those countries, the antenna on the pickup car will be in the middle.

clues.summary: A desert with a blurred pickup and an antenna on the left. UAE and Oman pickup coverage looks similar, but the antenna is in the middle there.
